name: What preventative measures can I take to maintain fence stability?

mainEntity.name: What preventative measures can I take to maintain fence stability?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maintain fence stability, regularly inspect your fence for signs of wear, rot, or damage. Keep the base of the fence clear of debris and excessive moisture to prevent rot. Ensure proper drainage around fence posts to avoid soil erosion. Periodically check and tighten fasteners, and promptly address any loose boards or pickets. Applying sealants or paints can also help protect wooden fences from weather damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regularly inspect, keep the base clear of debris/moisture, ensure proper drainage, tighten fasteners, and apply sealants/paints.
